# Signed history rewrite map

On 2026-09-27, the 413 unpublished `main` commits after signed remote base
`f63d9609cc230ad40d9d519513ddcb7c8dd61865` were rewritten solely to add GPG
commit signatures. For every mapped commit, the tree, commit message, author
identity/date, committer identity/date, and parent topology were preserved
byte for byte; parent object IDs changed only where an unpublished parent was
likewise signed. The existing merge topology (14 merges) was retained. No
content change was needed: live Deepwyrm dependency pins already name
published signed commits, and the two unpublished Deepwyrm identities in test
fixtures are data, resolved by Deepwyrm's corresponding 2026-09-27 map.

Every replacement signature verifies against fingerprint
`3068C88C61756A2D772F8C3D84A0F71707AE3AB8`. The original tip
`d2fae5f481fc7985d42be729345c663951942f1f` remains recoverable through
`refs/backup/wyrmroot-pre-sign-main-20260927-d2fae5f`. Its signed same-tree
replacement is `2c763864744ca4a9e46c8bbfe95b07bddac4d767`.

Historical validation and evidence files intentionally retain a pre-sign
identity when that identity is part of the request, receipt, artifact path, or
provenance bytes originally accepted. Use this map to resolve those identities
to the canonical signed history; do not rewrite immutable evidence.
